name: AI Responder
description: Auto-replies to inbound WhatsApp messages with an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. Single-turn, rate-limited per chat and per session, and last in the responder chain.
author: Abhinav Raj <92502850+probably-ABHINAV@users.noreply.github.com>

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://api.groq.com/openai/v1. Must be https, and an https host set here is added to the outbound allowlist automatically. http is accepted only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], which also needs SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS on the gateway.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Bearer key for the provider. Stored as a secret and sent only to the API base URL.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id sent with every request.

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: Optional instructions for tone and scope. Not secret: any contact can try to make the model reveal or ignore it, so never put confidential data here.

respondInGroups.title: Also respond in group chats
respondInGroups.description: Off by default. When on, every message in every group the account is in is sent to the provider.

maxRepliesPerChatPerHour.title: Max replies per chat per hour
maxRepliesPerChatPerHour.description: Messages answered per chat per clock hour. Messages over the limit are left to the rest of the chain. Kept in memory, so a restart resets it.

maxRepliesPerSessionPerHour.title: Max replies per session per hour
maxRepliesPerSessionPerHour.description: Messages answered per WhatsApp session per clock hour, across all chats. Bounds provider cost. Kept in memory, so a restart resets it.

maxInputChars.title: Max input characters
maxInputChars.description: The message text sent to the provider is cut to this many characters.

maxOutputTokens.title: Max output tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Sent as max_tokens, bounding the length and cost of each reply.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Provider request timeout. Clamped to 1000-25000 ms, below the host's 30000 ms per-call ceiling.
